observations.body: holding fast, living, forsaking, dying, turning, walking, and receiving light
observations.label: Actions in view

observations.body: Baruch does not call wisdom a tree of life even though its verbs closely meet Proverbs 3
observations.label: Inference boundary

observations.body: Baruch identifies wisdom with God’s commandments, says those who hold her fast will live and those who leave her will die, and calls Israel happy.
observations.label: Source posture

payload.posture: Read “Those who hold wisdom fast will live” as its own Scripture Scene before carrying its image into another source.
payload.tension: the passage shows wisdom held fast as the stated way to life, while Baruch does not call wisdom a tree of life even though its verbs closely meet Proverbs 3.
payload.title: Those who hold wisdom fast will live
